summary: Contestants draw two business-related topics, select one, and have ten minutes to prepare a speech using only provided notecards. They then deliver a two to four minute speech to judges, demonstrating effective communication and organization skills.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes preparation
No less than two (2) and no more than four (4) minutes speech
competencies: Communicate ideas clearly, professionally, and confidently through effective speaking skills
Apply professional communication strategies to develop a structured speech using storytelling, data visualization, and audience-focused messaging
Apply speaking techniques using appropriate tempo, pitch, and nonverbal gestures as needed

rubric.description: Contestant maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
The speech content flows adequately, and the contestant demonstrates a clear and well-integrated structure throughout.
Speech demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information.
Speech lasted no less than two (2) and no more than four (4) minutes.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Finals may be part of the competition
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
Contestant will be given warnings via flash cards when there is one (1) minute remaining and when there are thirty (30) seconds remaining during the speaking time
SPEECH WILL BE STOPPED AT FOUR (4) MINUTES
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this judged event.
Contestants may not enter both Extemporaneous Speech and Prepared Speech in the same year.
